proposals.rationale: Root signs messages as mike with `ssh-keygen -Y sign -n mshkn`. This verb is the pre-turn hook that lets the public door be opened safely: it receives the decoded payload (the JSON text of an object with `msg` and `sig`), verifies the detached signature against mike's baked-in public key (namespace mshkn, identity mike), and on success prints `mike` on stdout. With `asserts: ssh`, a successful hook yields the principal ssh:mike. Any failure exits non-zero and the turn stays anonymous. Signed-message convention: send `{"msg": "<text>", "sig": "<armor>"}`, signing exactly the msg text (e.g. `printf '%s' "$msg" | ssh-keygen -Y sign -f ~/.ssh/mike -n mshkn`); the verifier also tolerates one trailing newline on msg and/or sig. Approve this verb before the accompanying policy.
proposals.title: verify_mike: ssh-ed25519 signature hook to authenticate the public door

verb.description: Pre-turn hook for the public door: takes the decoded payload (JSON text with `msg` and `sig`), verifies mike's ssh-ed25519 signature (namespace mshkn) over `msg`, and on success prints the asserted identity `mike` (principal becomes ssh:mike). Any failure exits non-zero, leaving the principal anonymous.
